Korean markets are closed today for Liberation Day. This edition covers the overnight close abroad and preparation for the next Korean session , with Friday 14 August as the reference point. Overnight, US July retail sales fell 0.6% against a +0.1% consensus — the steepest drop in 14 months — and Michigan consumer sentiment slumped to 51.0 . Yet only the indices fell: S&P 500 −0.17% at 7,785.76 and Nasdaq −0.28%, while the Russell 2000 rose 0.51% and seven of the eleven sector ETFs gained . What weighed was Broadcom −5.94% , after BofA flagged USD 370bn of debt behind AI accelerators — while AMD rose 6.50% on a USD 47.5bn bond and a doubled price target. The argument has moved from AI demand to AI debt. In Korea, Friday closed with the KOSPI at 6,977.94 (+2.42%) after touching 7,010.86 , a fifth straight gain and +11.49% on the week , with advancers rebounding from 333 to 677 as leadership shifted from semiconductors to Hyundai Motor (+8.24%) and telecoms. The next Korean session is Tuesday 18 August — with Monday closed, it absorbs two sessions each from the US and Europe. 소비는 꺾였고 금리는 올랐습니다 Consumption broke, yields rose 기준: 미국·유럽·아시아·국내 모두 8월 14일(금) 마감 · 시세 파일 08-15 15:28 수집(직접 요청) · 작성 2026-08-17(월) 07:45 KST · 국내 증시 휴장일 판 — 내일 재개장 Basis: the US, Europe, Asia and Korea all as of the close on Friday 14 August · data collected 15:28 on request · compiled 07:45 KST, Monday 17 August 2026 · Korean market holiday edition — reopening tomorrow 각 항목을 클릭하면 근거 수치와 배경, 원문 링크가 펼쳐집니다. 고객 전달용은 «요약 PDF», 브리핑 준비용은 «전체 PDF» 로 저장하십시오. KOSPI closed at 6,258.77, down 37.61 points (−0.60%). The close reads as a mild loss, but the index ran from a high of 6,415.60 to a low of 6,158.73 — a 256.87-point range, 4.00% of the high. It opened 1.09% higher, reached 6,415 in the morning, fell to 6,158 in the afternoon, and recovered 100 points into the close. The trigger was SK Hynix, down 4.88% on reports that Nvidia is considering lower HBM specifications for its next-generation “Rubin Ultra” chip, with foreigners selling close to KRW 860bn. Yet on KOSPI 554 stocks rose against 322 that fell : LG Energy Solution +4.35%, Hanwha Aerospace +4.08%, Samsung Electro-Mechanics +3.99%, KB Financial +2.51% — only large-cap semis pushed the index down. On KOSDAQ, by contrast, 829 fell against 808 that rose : broadly, evenly soft. The two markets behaved in opposite ways. The won firmed 7.7 to 1,416.1.
